question: Why does this teaching include the full range up to Shiva?
premises: The text on contemplations teaches the range up to Shiva through many divisions.
Here nothing appears that is not truly real, unlike in other systems.
For those abiding in the level of truth, nothing can fall into what must be rejected.
inference: Because all manifestations are grounded in truth, the contemplative teaching can validly encompass the entire range up to Shiva.
plain_english: The teaching on contemplations is set forth in many divisions up to Shiva. For here, unlike in other systems, nothing appears that is not truly real; so for those who abide in the level of truth, what could possibly fall into the realm of what must be rejected?
